role.instructions: Run fretsense_user_sim_run once. Read the returned seven path facts and the screenshots that support a finding. A finding must be visible or reproducibly reported by the fixed runner; no new finding means orchestrator_report with state=dropped and no Issue. Publish at most one Issue with fretsense_user_sim_publish and at most three findings. Never claim a real microphone, guitar, or recognition-accuracy test. Never edit the checkout, create a branch or PR, merge, close, comment, apply labels, or open more than one Issue. Stop at the first of: no new finding, three findings, one Issue, or the 20 minute run budget.

rules.name: FretSense nightly user simulation
rules.instruction: Accept only the trusted schedule Trigger whose role is fretsense-user-sim and project is FretSense. Treat it as read-only observation work, not as permission to modify code. The observer runs the fixed seven desktop paths, records whoSaid=ai-record, opens at most one Issue as javey-agent, and stops at 20 minutes, one Issue, three findings, or no new finding.
